scope: Product Admin category/attribute catalog reads, native tenant admission, selected transport parity, and public error boundary

findings.finding: The crate-root export pointed directly to transport::fetch_catalog_search_options, bypassing CatalogSearchOptionsErrorContext. The raw executor is now crate-private and the public export points to catalog_transport::fetch_catalog_search_options.

Native schema reads and native catalog list/facet server functions did not consistently enforce the Product tenant module gate. The shared native schema context and list/facet endpoints now check module enablement and tenant-bound RequestContext.

Category and attribute reads used native-first/GraphQL-fallback execution, contrary to the build-profile selected transport contract. SSR/hydrate now use native and CSR uses GraphQL, without cross-transport retries.
Native facet errors were converted to None without diagnostics. The selected transport read context now records bounded failure shape and selected transport before the optional facet result degrades.

GraphQL ProductCatalogReadPort contexts used deterministic operation/page strings, while native list/facet contexts generated their own values and omitted channel. Both now use the trusted RequestContext correlation ID and channel.

The Next.js product route used the package default locale lookup instead of the host's effective locale header and cookie contract. It now uses EFFECTIVE_LOCALE_HEADER, LOCALE_COOKIE, locales, and defaultLocale from the host config.

The Next.js server-paginated catalog did not clamp page requests against the owner total, so a deep link could show page 99 of 2 with no rows. It now redirects to the last valid page while preserving filters and page size.

Schema-authoring mutations still have a native-first/GraphQL-fallback adapter and require a separate atomic selected-transport cutover. Product detail, pricing, and shipping-profile reads remain GraphQL-only.

preserved: ProductCatalogSearchOptions DTO and public Result value shape
GraphQL bootstrap/categories/attributes documents and request variable contract for CSR
native server function contract for SSR/hydrate
category and attribute option label projection
Product owner read-port filtering and facet count semantics
remaining_scope: Product detail, pricing, and shipping-profile native parity
focused verifier, Cargo, formatting, browser, and mounted execution
